design: Frozen H1004old,mixed,andrealanchor rank128. Two new seeded Gaussian constraints projected outside oldtask128 like real anchor, then127training-only mixed residual PCA directions. Same mixed center and rank. Whole-state fidelity plus donor-difference causal fidelity on old task contexts and all H1002action pairs; native-failing cohorts remain diagnostics.
evaluation: All old original-six non-discovery context states, retaining native failures as diagnostic; all80 H1002states with native-gate eligibility; all256 H998confirmation states from64documents, fourpositions each. No original whole-task holdouts evaluated. Paired edits include old contexts and new action pairs only; nuisance pairs excluded.
metrics: KL(native || reconstructed), native-top1 agreement, centered squared-error ratio. Macro average old native-passing cohorts and natural documents. Natural top1 agreement is fidelity, not ground-truth accuracy.
limits: Dense PCA geometry, not sparse features. Mixed objective equalizes domain sample counts, not activation energies. All arms rank128; own-domain centers differ except explicit old-center diagnostics. Natural confirmation reused for development; no final-test claim. Reconstruction denominator uses fixed oldtaskcenter for comparability.
